usage: As a verb, 複製 means to copy text, files, or objects from one place to another.
複製 can also be used as a noun, referring to the copied item itself.
In commands or instructions, 複製 is often used to tell someone to make a duplicate.
It is commonly paired with 貼上 (paste) to describe copying and pasting actions.
複製 is mostly used with digital content but can also refer to physical copying.

examples.meaning: I want to copy this piece of text.
